title: Clean-up using AMPure XP beads
author: Bioline
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f3ebqje

steps.title: Homogenize AMPure XP beads
steps.instruction: Mix the AMPure XP beads thoroughly until the reagent appears homogeneous and color‑consistent; use only room‑temperature beads.

steps.title: Add beads to DNA sample
steps.instruction: Add 117 μL of the homogeneous AMPure XP beads to each adaptor‑ligated DNA sample (in 1.5 mL LoBind tubes or 0.2 mL LoBind tubes) and mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.

steps.title: Bind DNA on magnetic stand
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a magnetic stand and wait 3–5 min for the solution to clear.

steps.title: Discard supernatant while on magnet
steps.instruction: Keep the tube in the magnetic stand, do not touch the beads, and carefully discard the cleared supernatant.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: While the tube remains on the magnet, add 70 % ethanol: 500 μL for 1.5 mL LoBind tubes or 200 μL for 0.2 mL LoBind tubes (wash 1/2).

steps.title: Incubate and remove ethanol (wash 1)
steps.instruction: Let the tube sit for 1 min to allow any disturbed beads to settle, then remove the ethanol (wash 1/2).

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: While the tube remains on the magnet, add 70 % ethanol again: 500 μL for 1.5 mL LoBind tubes or 200 μL for 0.2 mL LoBind tubes (wash 2/2).

steps.title: Seal and brief centrifugation
steps.instruction: Seal the tube or plate and centrifuge briefly at 260 × g for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Magnet incubation after centrifugation
steps.instruction: Return the tube to the magnetic stand and wait 1 min.

steps.title: Dry beads on 37 °C heat block
steps.instruction: Dry the samples on a 37 °C heat block for 3–5 min or until all residual ethanol evaporates; do not over‑dry (yield decreases). The bead pellet is dry when its surface changes from shiny to matte.

steps.title: Elute DNA with nuclease‑free water
steps.instruction: Add 32 μL nuclease‑free water directly to the bead pellet and mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.

steps.title: Consolidate sample and clear solution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly to consolidate the sample, then place on the magnetic stand for 2–3 min or until the solution is clear.

steps.title: Transfer eluate and discard beads
steps.instruction: Remove 30 μL of the supernatant and transfer it to a fresh LoBind tube; discard the beads.

steps.title: Incubate eluate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the transferred eluate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Settle beads and remove ethanol (wash 2)
steps.instruction: Let the tube sit for 1 min to allow any disturbed beads to settle, then remove the ethanol (wash 2/2).

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol with P20
steps.instruction: Using a P20 pipette and tip, carefully remove any remaining ethanol without touching the bead pellet.

steps.title: Final room‑temperature incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 3 min at room temperature.
